notes: §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SR4 has two bars. The GLOBAL half ("The same data-name must not be used as the name of an item possessing the global attribute and as the name of any other data item described in the program") is DataBinder.ScreenGlobalNameUniqueness (CheckGlobalNameUniquenessPass), COBOL6862 with a 1985 message arm; the EXTERNAL half ("the same data-name must not be used as the name of an external record and as the name of any other external data item described in any program contained within or containing the program") is ExternalRecordNameRules.Check, COBOL7282 (kb/Work PB5427 landed). Re-read 2026-11-15 (registrar landing records-1985-reread): the adjudicator's and refuter's probes of op-20261115/open-rows-1985 re-run on this branch's build (main 2722570af0) at --std 85, logs op-20261115/registrar-1985-reread/log-fmt.txt, log-misc.txt, log-witnesses.txt. The EXTERNAL half holds on every probe: refused in the same program, from an EXTERNAL FD's record, and in a contained program (r3-ext-bad, s4-x-same, s4-x-fd, COBOL7282); siblings, a non-external local item and two programs sharing the record compile and run (s4-x-sib XA XB, s4-x-local LO OU, r3-ext-ok INR [ABCD]). The GLOBAL half refuses an elementary reuse of a GLOBAL 01 name (r3-glob-bad) and accepts a condition-name and a contained program's local items (s4-g-cond G W, s4-g-nested-ok I IG O). Open, an adjudication and not yet a defect: whether the SUBORDINATES of a GLOBAL entry possess the global attribute. The compiler (reading A, §1985:X.4.6.4 GR1 "All data-names subordinate to a global name are global names") refuses r3-glob-sub, s4-g-within, s4-g-twosub and s4-g-fd with COBOL6862; reading B (§1985:X.4.6.4 GR3, X.1.3.8.3, X.4.6.3 SR2 attach the attribute to the entry that carries the clause) makes them legal. Owner: kb/Work PB5629 (open, needs adjudication; dated file 2026-11-15-refuter-case-global-subordinates). The stored record's earlier "open reading" (a GLOBAL 01's subordinate reused locally compiled) is gone: it is refused now, which is reading A.

next.reason: 1985 bars reusing an external record's data-name for another external item 'described in any program contained within or containing the program which describes that external data record'. 2023 states the bar in the uncataloged prose of §2023:8.4.2.1, 'as the name of any other external data item described in the run unit'. The scope widened from the containment nest to the whole run unit, which covers separately compiled programs: stricter. The global-name half is unchanged ('in the source element that describes that global data item'). The qualification formats map to §2023:8.4.2.2.2, which drops the cd-name qualifier (communication removed) and adds the report-name qualifier and further formats. Catalog defect: the §2023:8.4.2.1 paragraph that carries the external/global bar has no rule id, so 'to' cannot name it.
